features.name: Measure flat-rate catalogue churn (spike 16 follow-up)
features.description: At least 24 h after 2026-11-16, copy spikes/16-recommendation/catalog_stats.json aside (the re-run overwrites it), re-run catalog.py and churn.py against catalog_ids_2026-11-16.json.gz: movies leaving and entering flat-rate across ES/US/BO combined, per day. Sets the retention eviction threshold and re-ingest schedule (architecture Q12). TMDB only, $0.

features.name: Walking skeleton: search end to end
features.description: POST /search end to end on the ~300 spike-16 movies (the seed script re-fetches their TMDB bundles; raw TMDB data is not committed) in atlas-local: QueryIntent via Pydantic AI + gpt-6-luna (incl. a note for constraints it can't map), fastembed query vector, $vectorSearch with the pre-filters (verifying the untested ones and the audience rule), step-4 checks, re-rank + pitch, response states, exclude_ids (US3), trace with timings and cost; a minimal static provider list. Adds the first deterministic evals (P1, P3 as applied, P4, pitch length, real IDs, schema). First end-to-end latency numbers (Q7); answers Q4 on Windows. Split at /spec time if it holds independent behaviours.

features.name: Profile design and owner-rated sample
features.description: Finalize the v1 profile vocabulary with anchored definitions (viewing_effort, tone), the enrichment prompt and prompt_version, whether profiles keep an evidence field, and a profile-quality eval on ~30 films the owner rates (ADR 0005).
